title: Recording with Luis Russell and King Oliver
summary: Russell recorded under everyone's name; Holmes made 'Tight Like That', 'Savoy Shout' and 'Call of the Freaks' without knowing titles, plus Oliver dates with Metcalf.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: But you did some recordings now. Weren't you getting into...
Oh, we were recording all the time. Like I told you, we started with...
King Oliver.

...King Oliver and different ones. Yeah, Russell was recording for everybody, and under everybody's name. Red Allen's name and Higgenbotham's name, and... everybody's name but mine -- he never had me down on those recording dates.
But the first recording was under King Oliver's name, and King Oliver was in the studio...
That's true.
...but he didn't play.
No, he didn't play.
Right.
Holmes (10/9) - 82
I don't know if it was under his name. "Tight Like That." That's under Russell's name.
No, that's under Russell's name.
That was the first one we made. With him. That's the first one that I made.
Yeah, you made "Savoy Shout," "Call of the Freaks"...
That's Luis Russell.
...and "Tight Like That.." Yeah, that's all under Russell's name. And under King Oliver's name, you made "Slow and Steady."
Could be. I never heard it.
Well, we'll get to that when we play the records.
Have you got the records?
Yeah, I have the records, but I haven't got it with me now.
Yeah, I know.
But we'll play them later.
I have never even heard it. I don't know... See, I didn't ever know the titles of the numbers. We'd record things, and I'd never know what the title is until the number come out.
And later, under Oliver's name, you also made "West End Blues," "I've Got That Thing"...
"West End Blues" was made under King
Holmes (10/9) - 83
Oliver's name, but that's with Metcalf,
But Metcalf is the trumpeter, yeah.
Metcalf was in the band then. Because we used to give him hell when he was making that introduction, just before the last note he stopped and taken a breath! Ha-ha-ha!
Yeah. You can hear that on the record, too.
Yeah, he stopped and taken a breath, and they'd give him hell about that. Teddy Hill gave him hell. Boy, Teddy was on him everything he did.
